Date of Last Exposure to Treatment
Parameter Code
derivation: Assigned per SAP: 'PFS' for Progression-Free Survival, 'OS' for Overall Survival

label: Parameter
derivation: Assigned per SAP: 'Progression-Free Survival' for PARAMCD=PFS, 'Overall Survival' for PARAMCD=OS

label: Time Origin Date
derivation: For PFS: ADSL.TRTSDT (date of first dose). For OS: ADSL.TRTSDT (date of first dose).

label: Analysis Date
derivation: For PFS (PARAMCD=PFS): If event (CNSR=0), date of first disease progression or death from ADAE where AEDECOD indicates progression or death, converted from AESTDTC with partial-date imputation: sponsor convention - REVIEW; else (CNSR=1) censoring date per SAP (e.g., last known alive date from ADSL or DS). For OS (PARAMCD=OS): If event (CNSR=0), date of death from DM.DTHDTC converted with partial-date imputation: sponsor convention - REVIEW; else (CNSR=1) censoring date per SAP (e.g., last known alive date). [REVIEW: DM is not an input of ADTTE (inputs: ADAE, ADSL)]

label: Censoring Variable
derivation: For PFS: 0 if disease progression or death event occurred (per AEDECOD criteria), 1 if censored (no event by data cutoff or lost to follow-up). For OS: 0 if death occurred (DM.DTHFL='Y'), 1 if censored (alive at data cutoff). [REVIEW: DM is not an input of ADTTE (inputs: ADAE, ADSL)]

label: Event or Censoring Description
derivation: For PFS: If CNSR=0, 'Disease Progression' or 'Death' per AEDECOD; if CNSR=1, 'Censored: No Event' or 'Censored: Lost to Follow-up'. For OS: If CNSR=0, 'Death'; if CNSR=1, 'Censored: Alive at Data Cutoff'.

label: Source Domain
derivation: For PFS: 'AE' if event from ADAE, 'DS' if censoring from disposition, 'DM' if from demographics. For OS: 'DM' for death date, 'DS' or 'ADSL' for censoring date.

label: Source Variable
derivation: For PFS event: 'AESTDTC'; for PFS censoring: 'DSSTDTC' or 'RFENDTC'; for OS event: 'DTHDTC'; for OS censoring: 'DSSTDTC' or 'RFENDTC'.

label: Source Sequence Number
derivation: For PFS event: ADAE.AESEQ; for PFS censoring: DS.DSSEQ or null; for OS event: null (DM has no sequence); for OS censoring: DS.DSSEQ or null. [REVIEW: DS is not an input of ADTTE (inputs: ADAE, ADSL)]
